sources.title: Energizer Alkaline Handbook, Figure 12, plus the fresh open-circuit example
sources.ref: Three cells in series. Figure 12 (2018 handbook, page 11) is one AA cell at 0.1 A, ending at 0.8 V after 25 h. The text states 1.2 V at 15 h and 0.8 V at 25 h. The other knots were read off that figure. Reading tolerance is about 0.02 V on the cell, 0.06 V on the pack. Each loaded knot is three times the cell voltage plus 0.1 A times the pack rInternal (0.045 V), so the table is open circuit and the drop is not counted twice. The fresh point is the handbook's open-circuit example of 1.6 V, three cells, 4.8 V at soc 1, and it is not a point on the loaded curve. vCutoff stays 2.4 V, the terminal voltage where Figure 12 stops. Capacity is 9000 C, 0.1 A times 25 h, and a series pack has one cell's charge.

sources.title: Energizer E91 datasheet, nominal internal resistance
sources.ref: Fresh cylindrical alkaline internal resistance is 0.15 ohm to 0.3 ohm. The pack uses 0.45 ohm, the low end of that range times three cells. Fig. 9's dual-pulse example is 0.214 ohm for one cell; the low end of the fresh range is the choice here.

sources.title: Three cells, not four
sources.ref: Four fresh cells are about 6.4 V. A Nano 5V pin absolute maximum is 6 V, so four cells are above what that pin may take. This pack is three cells, about 4.8 V fresh.
